entries.title: Customer cohorts
entries.description: The risk and failure cohorts the golden corpus must cover and the policy gates reason about. A risk cohort is assigned from stable case attributes and decides which evidence obligations apply and whether automatic approval is even in scope. A failure cohort describes a way the case or the platform can go wrong; each one has a required outcome that evaluation must reproduce.

metadata.description: The risk and failure cohorts the golden corpus must cover and the policy gates reason about. riskCohorts.name: Low-risk standard individual
riskCohorts.description: The only cohort in which a deterministic gate may approve without a human, and then only while a current signed attestation covers it.

failureCohorts.name: Screening provider outage
failureCohorts.description: A required screening provider was unavailable or degraded.

failureCohorts.name: Stale sanctions list version
failureCohorts.description: Screening ran against a list version outside the permitted window.

failureCohorts.name: Policy snapshot mismatch
failureCohorts.description: Evidence was produced against a different policy snapshot than the case pins.

failureCohorts.name: Missing policy authority
failureCohorts.description: No authoritative policy evidence is linked to the case.

failureCohorts.name: Unsatisfied evidence obligation
failureCohorts.description: A required evidence obligation for the cohort is unmet.

failureCohorts.name: Evidence outside its freshness window
failureCohorts.description: Evidence for an obligation exists but has aged past the permitted window.

failureCohorts.name: Investigation not completed
failureCohorts.description: The public-source investigation work item never completed.

failureCohorts.name: Open material contradiction
failureCohorts.description: A HIGH-materiality contradiction remains open on the case.

failureCohorts.name: Identity conflict
failureCohorts.description: Investigation surfaced an unresolved identity conflict.

failureCohorts.name: Possible sanctions match
failureCohorts.description: Screening produced an unadjudicated possible sanctions match.

failureCohorts.name: Confirmed sanctions match
failureCohorts.description: Screening produced a confirmed sanctions match; escalated, never auto-declined.

failureCohorts.name: PEP signal
failureCohorts.description: Screening produced a politically exposed person signal.

failureCohorts.name: Adverse media in lookback window
failureCohorts.description: Adverse media findings require analyst assessment.

failureCohorts.name: Agent recommends decline
failureCohorts.description: The agent recommended DECLINE; the platform must route to human authority.

failureCohorts.name: Uncited recommendation
failureCohorts.description: The recommendation omits required policy or evidence citations.

failureCohorts.name: No recommendation present
failureCohorts.description: The decision agent produced no recommendation at all.

failureCohorts.name: Low-confidence recommendation
failureCohorts.description: Recommendation confidence is below the automatic-disposition threshold.

failureCohorts.name: Approval requirement unmet at disposition
failureCohorts.description: The case passed decision readiness but an obligation the approval bar checks is still unmet. The recommendation evidence is the usual one: decision readiness cannot require it, because the recommendation does not exist yet.

failureCohorts.name: Automatic-approval attestation absent
failureCohorts.description: An otherwise approvable low-risk case lacks a current cohort attestation.

failureCohorts.name: Cohort outside automatic-approval scope
failureCohorts.description: An approvable case sits in a cohort that may not be approved automatically.

failureCohorts.name: Undeterminable policy input
failureCohorts.description: A required condition could not be determined from the case snapshot.

failureCohorts.name: Superseded case snapshot
failureCohorts.description: The evaluated snapshot is older than the case's current sequence.

failureCohorts.name: Candidate bundle with unresolved institution settings
failureCohorts.description: The pinned bundle's owner inputs are not resolved, so no disposition may be reached.

failureCohorts.name: Policy evaluation error
failureCohorts.description: The policy engine could not produce a decision.

Nothing else counts as satisfaction.

entries.title: Policy owner inputs
entries.description: Institution-specific values this catalog deliberately does not invent. Each entry names what is missing, who owns it, what the platform does until it arrives, and whether it blocks production release. The placeholder values below exist so the corpus and the compiled bundle are runnable in preproduction; none of them is an institutional decision, and every blocking entry must be resolved before Phase 4 release.

spec.releaseRule: An unresolved input with blocksRelease true blocks production release. A gate that depends on an unresolved input evaluates with the placeholder in preproduction and must fail closed to REVIEW in production until the value is supplied.

inputs.title: Sanctions provider selection, match threshold and list freshness window

inputs.title: Adverse media lookback window and relevance standard

inputs.title: PEP tiers in scope and decay period
inputs.question: Which PEP tiers and associate degrees are in scope, and for how long after leaving office?

inputs.title: Automatic-approval cohort definition and attestation authority

inputs.title: Evidence freshness windows and retention schedule
inputs.question: How long does each evidence class remain current, and how long is it retained?

inputs.title: Dual-control roles and separation of duties

inputs.title: Recommendation confidence threshold for automatic disposition
inputs.question: Below what confidence is a recommendation advisory only?

inputs.title: High-risk jurisdiction list and its source

inputs.title: Periodic review cadence and material-change triggers

entries.title: Decision reason codes
entries.description: Canonical reason codes emitted by the deterministic KYC policy gates. Every gate outcome carries exactly one primary reason code from this registry. The code, not the prose, is the stable contract: analyst queues, exports, audit packages and metrics all key on it. Codes are additive; a retired code keeps its number and is marked retired.

codes.summary: The case carries no authoritative policy evidence.
codes.analystGuidance: The policy context agent did not link KYC_POLICY_AUTHORITY evidence. Re-run policy resolution; do not proceed on an unpinned policy.

codes.summary: No applicable_kyc_policy claim exists on the case.
codes.analystGuidance: Re-run the policy context agent; screening cannot begin unpinned.

codes.summary: The policy claim digest does not match the case policy authority digest.
codes.analystGuidance: Evidence was produced against a different policy snapshot than the case is pinned to. Treat all downstream findings as suspect and restart the case at intake.

codes.summary: The pinned policy snapshot is older than the configured freshness window.
codes.analystGuidance: Re-pin the case to the current policy version and re-screen.

codes.summary: The evaluated case snapshot was superseded before the decision was applied.
codes.analystGuidance: The case changed between snapshot read and policy application. Re-evaluate against the current sequence; never apply a decision computed from a superseded snapshot.

codes.summary: The case carries no resolved policy context at decision readiness.
codes.analystGuidance: The applicable_kyc_policy claim is absent when it should already exist. Restart the case at policy resolution rather than deciding without context.

codes.summary: The pinned bundle's institution settings are unresolved or unapproved.
codes.analystGuidance: The bundle is a candidate, not an approved policy. No disposition may be reached against it. Resolve the outstanding owner inputs and promote an approved bundle; until then every case in flight is a human's to decide outside this gate.

codes.summary: Required customer identification attributes are absent from the case.
codes.analystGuidance: Name, date of birth, residential address and taxpayer identification number are required before screening. Request the missing attributes from intake.

codes.summary: Beneficial ownership information required for this cohort is missing.
codes.analystGuidance: Collect and verify beneficial ownership for the legal entity before the case can reach decision readiness.

codes.summary: One or more policy evidence obligations are unsatisfied.
codes.analystGuidance: The unsatisfied obligation IDs are listed in the evaluation detail. Obtain the evidence or route the case for an EDD exception decision.

codes.summary: Evidence satisfying an obligation is outside its freshness window.
codes.analystGuidance: Refresh the expired evidence before approval.

codes.summary: Enhanced due diligence obligations for an elevated or high-risk cohort are unmet.
codes.analystGuidance: Complete source-of-funds, relationship-purpose and EDD narrative obligations before the case may reach decision readiness.

codes.summary: The public-source investigation work item is not completed.
codes.analystGuidance: Await or re-dispatch the investigation work item.

codes.summary: No public-source investigation evidence is linked to the case.
codes.analystGuidance: Re-run investigation; a completed work item without evidence is not a result.

codes.summary: A required screening provider was unavailable or returned a degraded result.
codes.analystGuidance: Screening coverage is incomplete. Do not approve on partial coverage; re-screen once the provider recovers, or complete a manual screen and record it as evidence.

codes.summary: The sanctions list version used for screening is older than the permitted window.
codes.analystGuidance: Re-screen against the current list version before any disposition.

codes.summary: Screening produced a possible sanctions match requiring adjudication.
codes.analystGuidance: Adjudicate the alert against the list record. Clearing a sanctions alert requires dual control; it is never automatic.

codes.summary: Screening produced a confirmed sanctions match.
codes.analystGuidance: Escalate immediately under the sanctions procedure. The platform does not decline automatically; a human with sanctions authority owns the disposition and any blocking or reporting obligation.

codes.summary: A politically exposed person signal requires the policy-defined review path.
codes.analystGuidance: Confirm PEP tier and complete the EDD obligations for PEP relationships.

codes.summary: Adverse media within the policy lookback window requires analyst assessment.
codes.analystGuidance: Assess relevance, recency and subject attribution of the adverse media.

codes.summary: Investigation surfaced an unresolved identity conflict for the subject.
codes.analystGuidance: Resolve the identity conflict before any approval; re-verify identity evidence.

codes.summary: An open high-materiality contradiction exists on the case.
codes.analystGuidance: Resolve or accept the contradiction with rationale before disposition.

codes.summary: The subject jurisdiction is on the institution's high-risk list.
codes.analystGuidance: Complete the jurisdiction-specific EDD obligations and record the rationale.

codes.summary: No decision recommendation exists on the case.
codes.analystGuidance: The decision agent produced no recommendation; re-dispatch or review manually.

codes.summary: The recommendation explicitly requires human review.
codes.analystGuidance: Review the cited rationale, evidence and findings, then decide.

codes.summary: Recommendation confidence is below the configured automatic-disposition threshold.
codes.analystGuidance: Treat the recommendation as advisory only and decide on the evidence.

codes.summary: The recommendation omits required policy, finding or evidence citations.
codes.analystGuidance: An uncited recommendation is not reviewable. Decide from the case record and report the agent defect.

codes.summary: A decline recommendation was made; declines are never automatic.
codes.analystGuidance: Adjudicate the recommended decline. Only a human with decline authority, under dual control, may finalize a DECLINED disposition.

codes.summary: An approval was recommended but at least one approval requirement is unmet.
codes.analystGuidance: The unmet requirement IDs are in the evaluation detail; resolve or decide manually.

codes.summary: The case cohort is outside the attested automatic-approval scope.
codes.analystGuidance: Automatic approval is limited to attested low-risk cohorts. This case requires a human approval decision.

codes.summary: The automatic-approval cohort attestation is absent, expired or unverified.
codes.analystGuidance: Automatic approval requires a current, signed cohort attestation. Without it every case in the cohort is routed to a human.

codes.summary: The disposition requires a second approver under dual control.
codes.analystGuidance: Route to a second approver with the required role; the first approver may not self-confirm.

codes.summary: No disposition rule matched; the policy defaults to human review.
codes.analystGuidance: Nothing falls through to approval. Decide manually and report the uncovered combination to the policy owner so a rule can be authored.

codes.summary: A required policy input could not be determined from the case snapshot.
codes.analystGuidance: Missing information fails closed. The undetermined condition IDs are in the evaluation detail.

codes.summary: The policy engine failed to produce a decision.
codes.analystGuidance: Treat as no decision. The case stays where it is and goes to a human; an errored evaluation never advances a case.

codes.summary: Authoritative policy context is pinned and intake attributes are complete.
codes.analystGuidance: No action; the case may proceed to screening.

codes.summary: Policy, investigation and evidence obligations are sufficient for a recommendation.
codes.analystGuidance: No action; the case may proceed to decision.

codes.summary: Every approval requirement is satisfied for an attested automatic-approval cohort.
codes.analystGuidance: No action; the case is approved under the attested low-risk cohort scope.

entries.title: Customer due diligence rules
entries.description: The institution-reviewable inventory of US KYC rules this platform enforces or contributes evidence toward. Each rule states one obligation, names the reason code a gate emits when the obligation is unmet, and declares who may act on it. The catalog is the source of truth for rule IDs; decision tables and the compiled policy bundle may only cite IDs defined here.

metadata.description: The institution-reviewable inventory of US KYC rules this platform enforces or contributes evidence toward. Each rule states one obligation, names the reason code a gate emits when the obligation is unmet, and declares who may act on it. The catalog is the source of truth for rule IDs; decision tables and the compiled policy bundle may only cite IDs defined here.
metadata.authorityDisclaimer: Citations name the general US regulatory basis for the obligation. They are not legal advice and do not substitute for the institution's own approved policy text. Every rule carrying ownerInputRefs is unresolved until the named owner input is supplied.

rules.title: Core identifying attributes are collected
rules.statement: The case must carry the customer's legal name, date of birth, residential or business street address and taxpayer identification number before screening begins.

rules.title: Identity is verified before approval
rules.statement: Identity must be verified through documentary or non-documentary means and the verification result recorded as evidence before any approval disposition.

rules.title: Identity conflicts are resolved by a human
rules.statement: An unresolved conflict between identity attributes asserted at intake and those observed in verification or investigation blocks automatic disposition.

rules.title: Customer risk is rated before decision
rules.statement: Every case must carry a risk rating derived from customer type, jurisdiction, product and screening outcome before a disposition is permitted.
rules.authorityBasis: 31 CFR 1010.230(b); FFIEC BSA/AML Manual, Customer Due Diligence

rules.title: Beneficial ownership is collected for legal entity customers
rules.statement: For in-scope legal entity customers, identify applicable ownership-prong beneficial owners and one control person under the governing rule. Sole proprietors are outside the legal entity customer definition; their business identity is assessed separately.

rules.title: Sole proprietor business identity is established
rules.statement: Connect the individual customer to the trading business, its registration where applicable, and the purpose and authority for the relationship. This is distinct from legal-entity beneficial ownership certification.
rules.authorityBasis: 31 CFR 1020.220 and institution business-identity policy; FinCEN CDD FAQs E.4 excludes sole proprietorships from 1010.230 legal entity customers

rules.title: Purpose and expected activity are understood
rules.statement: The case must record the purpose of the relationship and expected activity profile before approval.

rules.title: Elevated and high risk cases complete enhanced due diligence
rules.statement: Cases rated elevated or high must satisfy the enhanced due diligence obligations, including source of funds and a documented EDD narrative, before decision readiness.
rules.authorityBasis: FFIEC BSA/AML Manual, Customer Due Diligence — higher risk customers

rules.title: PEP relationships require senior approval
rules.statement: A confirmed politically exposed person relationship requires enhanced due diligence and a senior human approval; it is never automatically approved.

rules.title: High-risk jurisdictions receive jurisdiction-specific review
rules.statement: A subject or counterparty jurisdiction on the institution's high-risk list requires a human review with jurisdiction-specific EDD before disposition.

rules.title: Sanctions screening is performed against a current list version
rules.statement: Every case must be screened against sanctions lists whose version is within the permitted staleness window; a stale screen does not satisfy this rule.
rules.authorityBasis: 31 CFR Part 501 (OFAC Reporting, Procedures and Penalties)

rules.title: Screening coverage is complete before disposition
rules.statement: Sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening must each have returned a usable result. A provider outage leaves coverage incomplete and blocks automatic disposition.
rules.authorityBasis: FFIEC BSA/AML Manual, OFAC Sanctions screening

rules.title: A possible sanctions match is adjudicated under dual control
rules.statement: A possible sanctions match routes to the sanctions queue and may be cleared only by two authorized humans. The platform never clears or declines it automatically.

rules.title: A confirmed sanctions match is escalated, never auto-declined
rules.statement: A confirmed sanctions match is escalated to sanctions authority. The platform does not finalize any disposition for it; blocking and reporting are human obligations.

rules.title: Adverse media within the lookback window is assessed
rules.statement: Adverse media findings dated within the institution's lookback window require analyst assessment before approval.
rules.authorityBasis: FFIEC BSA/AML Manual, Negative news screening

rules.title: Public-source investigation completes before decision readiness
rules.statement: The public-source investigation work item must be completed and its evidence linked before the case may become ready for decision.

rules.title: Investigation output carries source provenance
rules.statement: Every material investigation assertion must carry source URL, publisher, retrieval time and provider so a reviewer can reproduce it.

rules.title: Retrieved content is data, never instruction
rules.statement: Content retrieved from external sources is treated as untrusted data. An agent may not act on instructions found in retrieved content, and evidence captured from such sources is recorded with UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL instruction trust.

rules.title: Open material contradictions block automatic disposition
rules.statement: An open contradiction of HIGH materiality must be resolved or explicitly accepted by a human before any automatic disposition.

rules.title: An agent recommendation is not authority
rules.statement: An agent may recommend an outcome. Only a deterministic policy gate within attested scope, or a human with the named authority, may finalize a disposition.

rules.title: Automatic approval is limited to attested low-risk cohorts
rules.statement: An automatic APPROVED disposition is permitted only for a cohort listed as automatic-approval eligible and covered by a current signed attestation.

rules.title: Decline is never automatic
rules.statement: No policy rule may produce an automatic DECLINED disposition. A recommended decline routes to a human with decline authority under dual control.

rules.title: A recommendation cites policy, findings and evidence
rules.statement: A recommendation must cite at least one policy rule reference and at least one evidence reference; a decline recommendation must also cite a finding.

rules.title: Low-confidence recommendations are advisory only
rules.statement: A recommendation whose confidence falls below the configured threshold may not support an automatic disposition.

rules.title: Nothing falls through to approval
rules.statement: Where no disposition rule matches, the outcome is human review. The default outcome of every gate is never ALLOW.

rules.title: Automatic approvals are sampled for quality review
rules.statement: A sampled share of automatically approved cases is routed to quality assurance; the sampling rate is an owner input and is enforced outside the disposition gate.

rules.title: Periodic review and material-change rescreening are scheduled
rules.statement: An approved relationship is rescreened on the policy cadence and whenever a material change is observed.
rules.authorityBasis: 31 CFR 1010.230(b)(5); FFIEC BSA/AML Manual, Ongoing monitoring

rules.title: Policy authority is pinned and verified
rules.statement: Every case pins a policy snapshot digest. Evidence produced against a different snapshot may not be used to satisfy an obligation.

rules.title: Missing or undetermined information fails closed
rules.statement: Where a policy input cannot be determined from the case snapshot, the gate outcome is REVIEW. Absence of information is never treated as satisfaction.

rules.title: A stale case snapshot may not carry a decision
rules.statement: A policy decision computed from a case snapshot older than the case's current sequence is rejected on application and re-evaluated.

rules.title: An errored evaluation never advances a case
rules.statement: Where the policy engine fails, the outcome is ERROR, the case does not transition, and the case is routed to operations.

rules.title: A candidate bundle disposes of nothing
rules.statement: While the institution settings this policy depends on are unresolved or unapproved, the disposition gate reaches no outcome at all. A candidate bundle may be compiled, evaluated and shadowed, but it is never runtime authority over a customer.
rules.authorityBasis: Institution model risk policy; change control standard

rules.title: Every evaluation is recorded and replayable
rules.statement: Each gate evaluation records the policy bundle digest, gate ID, case sequence, evaluated rule IDs, condition values, outcome and reason codes, sufficient to replay the decision exactly.

rules.title: Human dispositions record actor, authority and rationale
rules.statement: A human disposition records the acting principal, the role conferring authority, the second approver where dual control applies, and the rationale.

entries.title: Case disposition
entries.description: What disposition, if any, may the platform reach without a human? The agent recommendation is one input among many and is never authority. The only automatic disposition this table can produce is APPROVED, and only for an attested low-risk cohort with every approval requirement satisfied. No row produces DECLINED.

metadata.description: What disposition, if any, may the platform reach without a human? The agent recommendation is one input among many and is never authority. The only automatic disposition this table can produce is APPROVED, and only for an attested low-risk cohort with every approval requirement satisfied. No row produces DECLINED.
metadata.precedence: Rows are evaluated in order and the first match wins. The order is deliberate and is itself the reviewable artifact: engine health, then snapshot currency, then sanctions, then identity and contradiction integrity, then the recommendation's own demands, then the risk signals that force review, then undetermined inputs, and only last the approval path. A case matching several rows reports the earliest, so the most serious reason is the one the analyst sees.

invariants.statement: No row in this table may carry disposition DECLINED or outcome BLOCK with a decline effect.
Any row producing ALLOW must require cohortEligibility ELIGIBLE and attestation VALID.
The table default is REVIEW; no combination falls through to ALLOW.
